normative_extracts.quote: An import map is a JSON object that allows authors to control how module specifiers are resolved when imported by JavaScript modules.

pipeline_phases: Parse <script type='importmap'> into Document Module Map
Match Bare Specifier via Longest-Prefix Scopes & Imports
Verify Optional SRI Hash from Integrity Map
engine_internals.mechanism_summary: The HTML parser builds an in-memory specifier map before module execution, resolving bare imports and path-scoped overrides directly to hashed URLs.

production_failures.symptom: LCP degrades by 400ms+ after switching from a single bundle to native ES modules with Import Maps
production_failures.root_cause: Transitive module imports are discovered sequentially as each parent module parses, creating a multi-RTT network waterfall.
production_failures.mitigation: Emit <link rel='modulepreload'> tags in the HTML head for critical transitive dependencies.

production_failures.symptom: Bare specifier TypeError in production when an inline analytics module runs early
production_failures.root_cause: The <script type='importmap'> appeared after a <script type='module'> or was injected dynamically after module resolution began.
production_failures.mitigation: Place the importmap script in <head> strictly before any module script or modulepreload link.
